en.name: JWT Decoder
en.short: Decode a JWT, check its expiry and verify its signature.
en.title: JWT Decoder & Verifier online (private)
en.description: Decode JSON Web Tokens online: header, payload and signature, with exp, iat and nbf as readable dates and an expiry warning. Verify HS, RS, ES and PS signatures. Runs 100% in your browser.
en.lead: Paste a token to see its header, payload and expiry. It is never stored or sent anywhere.
en.placeholder: Paste a JWT (eyJ…), with or without “Bearer ”
en.publicKey: Public key, certificate or JWK (to verify the signature)
